**#809 — brain:promote learns the migration shape; the proof precedes the plan**

Single-PR change in worktree brain-issue-809, off main@89f4b71. lib/migration-draft.mjs (brain-migration/1 contract: JSON never JS, declarative only — migrate() stays a hand edit; proposeVersion computed-only per #806, next-minor above max(package, tail), monotonic-forever pinned by test; anchor-refusing splicer) + the arm in brain-promote.mjs (basename dispatch before the ADR/amendment split; async planner; the D3 proof — temp import + migrateConfig over the candidate — runs BEFORE the plan is offered, so the human signs a verified result). D2 AMENDED during apply: no --as option — parseArgs's written 'no options' doctrine found and honored; recorded in the proposal addendum. The three pending drafts (1.2.0 #456, 1.3.0 #312, 1.4.0 #814) converted to the contract and pinned by a test parsing the real files. locks guard updated: migration-draft OWN, installer SHARED, verb spans four modules. Suite 4640/0. Tier 3 unchanged: the verb automates mechanics; the typed word and the human commit remain the signature.
